title: Python.org
summary: The official home of Python: downloads, release notes, and links to the language reference.
description: Start here for the current interpreter, installers for every supported platform, release schedules, and the official documentation portal. The site also links to community events, the Python Software Foundation, and the latest security releases.

title: Python Documentation
summary: The canonical language and standard library reference, versioned to the patch release.
description: The complete reference for syntax, built-in types, the standard library, and CPython internals. Use the version selector to match your interpreter, and keep the tutorial and library reference open while you work.

title: Python Getting Started
summary: A short official path from installing Python to running your first script.
description: Walks through installation on Windows, macOS, and Linux, then points to beginner tutorials, books, and communities. A safe first stop when you are setting up a new machine or helping someone start.

title: futurecoder
summary: An interactive, browser-based introduction to Python with immediate feedback.
description: Teaches variables, loops, functions, and debugging through short exercises that run in the browser. Hints and step-through execution make it useful for absolute beginners who want to practice instead of only reading.

title: Real Python
summary: Practical tutorials and deep dives across the language, from first scripts to production patterns.
description: A large library of Python tutorials, video courses, and cheat sheets written for working developers. Many articles are free; a membership unlocks the full course catalog and downloadable resources.

title: GeeksforGeeks Python
summary: A broad reference of Python concepts, examples, and interview-style explanations.
description: Covers syntax, data structures, object-oriented programming, libraries, and common interview questions with short examples. Useful for quick lookups and revision, though articles vary in depth and ads are plentiful.

title: W3Schools Python
summary: A quick-reference tutorial with runnable examples and short exercises.
description: A concise, example-first introduction to Python syntax, data types, functions, and file handling. The built-in editor lets you run snippets immediately, making it a low-friction first pass before deeper material.

title: Python Programming Tutorials
summary: Video-first tutorials spanning Python basics, data analysis, and machine learning.
description: Sentdex's long-running collection of project-driven Python tutorials. Follow along with building games, scraping data, training models, and working with APIs; most series are free and code is provided.

title: Corey Schafer — Python Tutorials
summary: A calm, well-paced video series covering language fundamentals and the standard library.
description: Corey Schafer's Python playlist moves from installation and syntax through functions, modules, file I/O, and object-oriented programming. Clear pacing and complete examples make it a strong companion to written docs.
